title: Pharmacy Franchise Opportunity
name: Hameed Latif Hospital Pharmacy, 6 Franchisees, Est'd in 1992, Lahore HQ
description: The business represents the retail expansion of Hameed Latif Hospital Pharmacy, leveraging over 35 years of trusted healthcare expertise to create a comprehensive health and wellness destination. Backed by the clinical reputation of Hameed Latif Hospital and Rashid Latif Medical College, the concept integrates a full-service pharmacy and retail store, nutritional supplements, home healthcare services, and a diagnostic sample collection centre under one roof, providing customers with a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience. Unlike a startup concept, the business is built on an established healthcare ecosystem with a strong foundation of patients, doctors, and supplier relationships. Pakistan's pharmacy market remains highly fragmented, with an estimated 40,000–50,000 outlets nationwide and no dominant organized retail chain, creating a significant opportunity for scalable growth. Key investment highlights include: - Over 35 years of established brand credibility in the healthcare sector. - Diversified revenue streams across pharmacy retail, nutritional supplements, home healthcare services, and diagnostic collections. - Strong financial outlook with an estimated breakeven period of six months and projected return on investment within 24 months. - Access to an existing network of healthcare professionals, patients, and suppliers, minimizing customer acquisition risk. - Planned expansion across high-footfall commercial locations in Punjab to strengthen market presence. - The business has a valid business registration certificate. With healthcare demand continuing to grow and consumer preference shifting toward organized and trusted healthcare providers, the company is well-positioned to scale its retail footprint and capitalize on the evolving pharmacy market.
